name: assay_context_structured
description: Protocol fields known at intended prediction time; never the outcome.

name: assay_description
description: Free text may quote endpoint values or labels and requires redaction audit.

name: canonical_smiles
description: Canonical molecular representation derived without outcome access.

name: clinical_outcome_summary
description: Human outcome occurring after the intended preclinical prediction time.

name: computational_prediction
description: Prediction features require model, training-cutoff, and overlap lineage.

name: cross_endpoint_observation
description: A distinct observed endpoint usable only if available at query time.

name: document_year
description: Time axis for temporal evaluation; may proxy outcome availability.

name: label_value
description: Observed or curated task label; never an input to its own task.

name: molecular_graph
description: Atom/bond graph generated deterministically from admitted SMILES.

name: molecule_id
description: Stable join, grouping, prediction, and error-analysis identifier.

name: morgan_fingerprint
description: RDKit Morgan fingerprint; radius and width are part of lineage.

name: p_value
description: Molar concentration transform of the same observation.

name: protein_sequence
description: Exact construct or resolved canonical sequence; missing is not negative.

name: protein_structure
description: Experimental or predicted coordinates with method and confidence.

name: rdkit_descriptors
description: Interpretable 2D descriptors calculated from the admitted structure.

name: source_id
description: Source is retained for heterogeneity, holdout, and error audits.

name: standardized_smiles
description: Parent/state-standardized structure; state policy must be versioned.

name: task_id
description: Routes an example to an endpoint-specific head; not a pooled label shortcut.
